entries.title: 给 Jimmy 请医生

facts.text: Where’s Jimmy?

facts.cn: 你看起来好多了，Jimmy。你现在好些了，但还不准起床。你必须再卧床两天。

facts.speaker: doctor

facts.cn: 这孩子还不准上学，Williams太太。而且他不准吃油腻的食物。

entries.title: 诊所里的预约时间
entries.story: 克罗夫特先生扶着面颊，与拿着预约本的护士交谈
entries.direction: Mr. Croft holds his painful cheek while talking to the nurse with an appointment book. Two adult figures; subtle concerned expression, no visible injured tooth or medical procedure.

facts.speaker: nurse
facts.text: Good morning, Mr. Croft.
facts.cn: 早上好，克罗夫特先生。

facts.speaker: croft
facts.text: Good morning, nurse. I want to see the dentist, please.
facts.cn: 早上好，护士。我想见牙科医生。

facts.speaker: nurse
facts.text: Do you have an appointment?
facts.cn: 您预约了吗？

facts.speaker: croft
facts.text: No, I don’t.
facts.cn: 没有。

facts.speaker: nurse
facts.text: Is it urgent?
facts.cn: 急吗？

facts.speaker: croft
facts.text: Yes, it is. It’s very urgent. I feel awful. I have a terrible toothache.
facts.cn: 是的，很急。我难受极了，牙痛得要命。

facts.speaker: nurse
facts.text: Can you come at 10 a.m. on Monday, April 24th?
facts.cn: 您在4月24日星期一上午10点来可以吗？

facts.speaker: croft
facts.text: I must see the dentist now, nurse.
facts.cn: 我必须现在见牙科医生，护士。

facts.speaker: nurse
facts.text: The dentist is very busy at the moment. Can you come at 2 p.m.?
facts.cn: 牙科医生这会儿很忙。您下午2点来可以吗？

facts.speaker: croft
facts.text: That’s very late. Can the dentist see me now?
facts.cn: 那就太晚了。牙科医生现在能给我看一下吗？

facts.speaker: nurse
facts.text: I’m afraid that he can’t, Mr. Croft. Can’t you wait till this afternoon?
facts.cn: 恐怕不行，克罗夫特先生。您就不能等到今天下午吗？

facts.speaker: croft
facts.text: I can wait, but my toothache can’t!
facts.cn: 我倒是可以等。可是我的牙痛等不了啊！

entries.title: 一起写购物清单
entries.story: Carol拿着笔和清单，与Tom讨论家里需要什么
entries.direction: Carol holds a pen and shopping list, Tom discusses what they need. Exactly two adults, abstract marks on paper only, no shopping purchases already delivered.

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: What are you doing, Carol?
facts.cn: 卡罗尔，你在做什么？

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: I’m making a shopping list, Tom.
facts.cn: 我在写购物清单，汤姆。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: What do we need?
facts.cn: 我们需要什么？

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: We need a lot of things this week.
facts.cn: 这个星期我们需要很多东西。

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: I must go to the grocer’s. We haven’t got much tea or coffee, and we haven’t got any sugar or jam.
facts.cn: 我得去食品杂货店。我们的茶和咖啡不多了，糖和果酱一点儿也没有了。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: What about vegetables?
facts.cn: 蔬菜呢？

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: I must go to the greengrocer’s. We haven’t got many tomatoes, but we’ve got a lot of potatoes.
facts.cn: 我得去蔬菜水果店。我们的番茄不多了，不过土豆还有很多。

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: I must go to the butcher’s, too. We need some meat. We haven’t got any meat at all.
facts.cn: 我还得去肉店。我们需要一些肉。一点儿肉也没有了。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: Have we got any beer and wine?
facts.cn: 我们还有啤酒和葡萄酒吗？

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: No, we haven’t. And I’m not going to get any!
facts.cn: 没有了。而且我不打算买！

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: I hope that you’ve got some money.
facts.cn: 我希望你还有一些钱。

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: I haven’t got much.
facts.cn: 我的钱不多了。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: Well, I haven’t got much either!
facts.cn: 唉，我的钱也不多了！

entries.title: 晚餐前的小意外
entries.story: Carol端着烤牛肉和土豆，Tom与来访的Sam聊起午餐
entries.direction: Carol carries a small plate of roast beef and potatoes while Tom talks to their visitor Sam. Exactly three full-body adults; one food plate, no second meal or enormous dining table.

facts.speaker: sam
facts.text: Hi, Carol! Where’s Tom?
facts.cn: 嗨，卡罗尔！汤姆在哪儿？

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: He’s upstairs. He’s having a bath.
facts.cn: 他在楼上。他正在洗澡。

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: Tom!
facts.cn: 汤姆！

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: Yes?
facts.cn: 什么事？

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: Sam’s here.
facts.cn: 萨姆来了。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: I’m nearly ready.
facts.cn: 我马上就好。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: Hello, Sam. Have a cigarette.
facts.cn: 你好，萨姆。请抽烟。

facts.speaker: sam
facts.text: No, thanks, Tom.
facts.cn: 不，谢谢，汤姆。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: Have a glass of whisky then.
facts.cn: 那么，来一杯威士忌吧。

facts.speaker: sam
facts.text: OK. Thanks.
facts.cn: 好的，谢谢。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: Is dinner ready, Carol?
facts.cn: 卡罗尔，饭好了吗？

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: It’s nearly ready. We can have dinner at seven o’clock.
facts.cn: 马上就好。我们七点可以吃晚饭。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: Sam and I had lunch together today. We went to a restaurant.
facts.cn: 萨姆和我今天一起吃了午饭。我们去了一家餐馆。

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: What did you have?
facts.cn: 你们吃了什么？

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: We had roast beef and potatoes.
facts.cn: 我们吃了烤牛肉和土豆。

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: Oh!
facts.cn: 噢！

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: What’s the matter, Carol?
facts.cn: 怎么了，卡罗尔？

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: Well, you’re going to have roast beef and potatoes again tonight!
facts.cn: 唉，你们今晚又要吃烤牛肉和土豆了！

entries.title: 出发前的行李箱
entries.story: Carol把蓝衬衫放进行李箱，Tom和来访的Sam聊假期
entries.direction: Carol puts one blue shirt into an OPEN suitcase on a low small stand while Tom and visiting Sam discuss the holiday. Exactly three adults; suitcase does not cover shoes. They have not departed.

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: Hello, Sam. Come in.
facts.cn: 你好，萨姆。请进。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: Hi, Sam. We’re having lunch. Do you want to have lunch with us?
facts.cn: 嗨，萨姆。我们正在吃午饭。你愿意和我们一起吃午饭吗？

facts.speaker: sam
facts.text: No, thank you, Tom. I’ve already had lunch. I had lunch at half past twelve.
facts.cn: 不，谢谢你，汤姆。我已经吃过午饭了。我十二点半吃的午饭。

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: Have a cup of coffee then.
facts.cn: 那么喝杯咖啡吧。

facts.speaker: sam
facts.text: I’ve just had a cup, thank you. I had one after my lunch.
facts.cn: 我刚喝过一杯，谢谢。我吃完午饭后喝了一杯。

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: Let’s go into the living room, Carol. We can have our coffee there.
facts.cn: 卡罗尔，我们到客厅去吧。我们可以在那里喝咖啡。

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: Excuse the mess, Sam. This room’s very untidy. We’re packing our suitcases. We’re going to leave tomorrow. Tom and I are going to have a holiday.
facts.cn: 萨姆，请原谅这里这么乱。这个房间很不整齐。我们正在收拾行李箱。我们打算明天出发。汤姆和我打算去度假。

facts.speaker: sam
facts.text: Aren’t you lucky!
facts.cn: 你们真幸运啊！

facts.speaker: tom
facts.text: When are you going to have a holiday, Sam?
facts.cn: 萨姆，你打算什么时候去度假？

facts.speaker: sam
facts.text: I don’t know. I’ve already had my holiday this year.
facts.cn: 我不知道。我今年已经休过假了。

facts.speaker: carol
facts.text: Where did you go?
facts.cn: 你去了哪里？

facts.speaker: sam
facts.text: I stayed at home!
facts.cn: 我待在家里了！

entries.title: 电影院外聊巴黎
entries.story: 电影院外，戴圆眼镜的George与拿票根的Ken聊起巴黎
entries.direction: George with round glasses talks to Ken holding cinema ticket stubs. Two full-body men as the card. They are outside the cinema discussing Paris, not actually in Paris; no Eiffel tower miniature in hands.

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: Hello, Ken.
facts.cn: 你好，肯。

facts.speaker: ken
facts.text: Hi, George.
facts.cn: 嗨，乔治。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: Have you just been to the cinema?
facts.cn: 你刚去过电影院吗？

facts.speaker: ken
facts.text: Yes, I have.
facts.cn: 是的，我刚去过。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: What’s on?
facts.cn: 在放映什么电影？

facts.speaker: ken
facts.text: Paris in the Spring.
facts.cn: 《巴黎之春》。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: Oh, I’ve already seen it. I saw it on television last year. It’s an old film, but it’s very good.
facts.cn: 噢，我已经看过了。我去年在电视上看的。这是部老电影，不过很好看。

facts.speaker: ken
facts.text: Paris is a beautiful city.
facts.cn: 巴黎是一座美丽的城市。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: I’ve never been there. Have you ever been there, Ken?
facts.cn: 我从没去过那里。肯，你去过那里吗？

facts.speaker: ken
facts.text: Yes, I have. I was there in April.
facts.cn: 是的，我去过。我四月在那里。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: Paris in the spring, eh?
facts.cn: 春天的巴黎，嗯？

facts.speaker: ken
facts.text: It was spring, but the weather was awful. It rained all the time.
facts.cn: 那时是春天，不过天气很糟。一直在下雨。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: Just like London!
facts.cn: 就像伦敦一样！

entries.title: 修理厂里的进度单
entries.story: Wood与接待员查看仍有凹痕的汽车和维修进度单
entries.direction: Wood and the receptionist inspect a repair progress sheet beside a SMALL partial dented car fender prop matching the card. Two complete men, do not show a repaired shiny car; fender only, not a life-size car overwhelming the figures.

facts.speaker: wood
facts.text: Is my car ready yet?
facts.cn: 我的车修好了吗？

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: I don’t know, sir. What’s the number of your car?
facts.cn: 我不知道，先生。您的车牌号码是多少？

facts.speaker: wood
facts.text: It’s LFZ 312 G.
facts.cn: 是LFZ 312 G。

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: When did you bring it to us?
facts.cn: 您什么时候把车送来的？

facts.speaker: wood
facts.text: I brought it here three days ago.
facts.cn: 我三天前把它送到这里的。

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: Ah yes, I remember now.
facts.cn: 啊，对了，我现在想起来了。

facts.speaker: wood
facts.text: Have your mechanics finished yet?
facts.cn: 你们的修理工修好了吗？

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: No, they’re still working on it. Let’s go into the garage and have a look at it.
facts.cn: 没有，他们还在修。我们到车库里看看吧。

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: Isn’t that your car?
facts.cn: 那不是您的车吗？

facts.speaker: wood
facts.text: Well, it was my car.
facts.cn: 嗯，它以前是我的车。

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: Didn’t you have a crash?
facts.cn: 您不是撞车了吗？

facts.speaker: wood
facts.text: That’s right. I drove it into a lamp-post. Can your mechanics repair it?
facts.cn: 是的。我把车撞到路灯柱上了。你们的修理工能修好它吗？

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: Well, they’re trying to repair it, sir. But to tell you the truth, you need a new car!
facts.cn: 嗯，他们正设法修呢，先生。不过说实话，您需要一辆新车了！

entries.title: 看房时的时间线索
entries.story: Nigel拿着看房笔记，与Ian讨论待售房屋，尚未决定购买
entries.direction: Nigel holds house-viewing notes while talking with Ian. Two adults, no key handover, no sold label, no handshake implying purchase; decision has NOT been made.

facts.speaker: nigel
facts.text: Good afternoon. I believe that this house is for sale.
facts.cn: 下午好。我想这房子是要出售的吧。

facts.speaker: ian
facts.text: That’s right.
facts.cn: 是的。

facts.speaker: nigel
facts.text: May I have a look at it, please?
facts.cn: 我可以看一看吗？

facts.speaker: ian
facts.text: Yes, of course. Come in.
facts.cn: 可以，当然可以。请进。

facts.speaker: nigel
facts.text: How long have you lived here?
facts.cn: 您在这里住了多长时间了？

facts.speaker: ian
facts.text: I’ve lived here for twenty years.
facts.cn: 我在这里已经住了二十年了。

facts.speaker: nigel
facts.text: Twenty years! That’s a long time.
facts.cn: 二十年！这时间可不短。

facts.speaker: ian
facts.text: Yes, I’ve been here since 1976.
facts.cn: 是的，从1976年起我就住在这里了。

facts.speaker: nigel
facts.text: Then why do you want to sell it?
facts.cn: 那么，您为什么想卖掉它呢？

facts.speaker: ian
facts.text: Because I’ve just retired. I want to buy a small house in the country.
facts.cn: 因为我刚退休。我想在乡下买一幢小房子。

facts.speaker: nigel
facts.text: How much does this house cost?
facts.cn: 这幢房子多少钱？

facts.speaker: ian
facts.cn: 六万八千五百英镑。

facts.speaker: nigel
facts.text: That’s a lot of money!
facts.cn: 这可是一大笔钱！

facts.speaker: ian
facts.text: It’s worth every penny of it.
facts.cn: 它确实值这么多钱。

facts.speaker: nigel
facts.text: Well, I like the house, but I can’t decide yet. My wife must see it first.
facts.cn: 我喜欢这房子，但现在还不能决定。我妻子必须先来看看。

facts.speaker: ian
facts.text: Women always have the last word.
facts.cn: 女人总是最后说了算。

entries.title: 邻居们的明日约定
entries.story: Catherine、Jenny和Linda在屋外谈论Ian明天的搬家安排与问候
entries.direction: Catherine, Jenny and Linda converse about Ian moving tomorrow. Exactly three women as the card, no Ian present, no moving boxes already carried away, no departure scene.

facts.speaker: catherine
facts.text: Has Ian sold his house yet?
facts.cn: Ian已经把房子卖掉了吗？

facts.speaker: jenny
facts.text: Yes, he has. He sold it last week.
facts.cn: 是的，卖掉了。他上星期卖的。

facts.speaker: catherine
facts.text: Has he moved to his new house yet?
facts.cn: 他已经搬进新房子了吗？

facts.speaker: jenny
facts.text: No, not yet. He’s still here. He’s going to move tomorrow.
facts.cn: 还没有。他仍在这里。他打算明天搬家。

facts.speaker: catherine
facts.text: When? Tomorrow morning?
facts.cn: 什么时候？明天上午吗？

facts.speaker: jenny
facts.text: No. Tomorrow afternoon. I’ll miss him. He has always been a good neighbour.
facts.cn: 不，明天下午。我会想念他的。他一直是个好邻居。

facts.speaker: linda
facts.text: He’s a very nice person. We’ll all miss him.
facts.cn: 他是个很好的人。我们都会想念他。

facts.speaker: catherine
facts.text: When will the new people move into this house?
facts.cn: 新住户什么时候搬进这幢房子呢？

facts.speaker: jenny
facts.text: I think that they’ll move in the day after tomorrow.
facts.cn: 我想他们会在后天搬进来。

facts.speaker: linda
facts.text: Will you see Ian today, Jenny?
facts.cn: Jenny，你今天会见到Ian吗？

facts.speaker: jenny
facts.text: Yes, I will.
facts.cn: 是的，我会见到他。

facts.speaker: linda
facts.text: Please give him my regards.
facts.cn: 请代我问候他。

facts.speaker: catherine
facts.text: Poor Ian! He didn’t want to leave this house.
facts.cn: 可怜的Ian！他本来不想离开这幢房子。

facts.speaker: jenny
facts.text: No, he didn’t want to leave, but his wife did!
facts.cn: 是啊，他不想离开，可是他妻子想离开！

entries.title: 新邻居的飞行手记
entries.story: 飞行员Nigel在机场窗边查看旅行手记，旁边放着地球仪与行李
entries.direction: Pilot Nigel alone checks his open travel journal beside a small globe on a low stand and one suitcase. Full uniform identity as card, complete body and shoes. No additional pilot or real aeroplane in cutout.

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: Nigel is our new next-door neighbour. He’s a pilot.
facts.cn: Nigel是我们新搬来的隔壁邻居。他是一名飞行员。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: He was in the R.A.F.
facts.cn: 他曾在英国皇家空军任职。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: He will fly to New York next month.
facts.cn: 下个月他将飞往纽约。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: The month after next he’ll fly to Tokyo.
facts.cn: 下下个月他将飞往东京。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: At the moment, he’s in Madrid. He flew to Spain a week ago.
facts.cn: 现在他在马德里。他是一星期以前飞往西班牙的。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: He’ll return to London the week after next.
facts.cn: 下下个星期他将返回伦敦。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: He’s only forty-one years old, and he has already been to nearly every country in the world.
facts.cn: 他只有四十一岁，却已经去过世界上几乎每一个国家。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: Nigel is a very lucky man. But his wife isn’t very lucky. She usually stays at home!
facts.cn: Nigel是个很幸运的人。不过他妻子不太幸运。她通常待在家里！

entries.title: 车站里的时间谜题
entries.story: George拿着两张车票，与Ken一起听车站乘务员解释
entries.direction: George holds TWO train tickets, Ken stands beside him, a station attendant explains the time. Three full-body men as the card, no boarding train, no invented clock reading.

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: Two return tickets to London, please. What time will the next train leave?
facts.cn: 请买两张去伦敦的往返票。下一班火车什么时候开？

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: At nineteen minutes past eight.
facts.cn: 八点十九分。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: Which platform?
facts.cn: 在哪个站台？

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: Platform Two. Over the bridge.
facts.cn: 二号站台。过天桥。

facts.speaker: ken
facts.text: What time will the next train leave?
facts.cn: 下一班火车什么时候开？

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: At eight nineteen.
facts.cn: 八点十九分。

facts.speaker: ken
facts.text: We’ve got plenty of time.
facts.cn: 我们的时间还很宽裕。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: It’s only three minutes to eight.
facts.cn: 现在才七点五十七分。

facts.speaker: ken
facts.text: Let’s go and have a drink. There’s a bar next door to the station.
facts.cn: 我们去喝点东西吧。车站旁有一家酒吧。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: We had better go back to the station now, Ken.
facts.cn: Ken，我们现在最好回车站去。

facts.speaker: porter
facts.text: Tickets, please.
facts.cn: 请出示车票。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: We want to catch the eight nineteen to London.
facts.cn: 我们想赶上八点十九分去伦敦的火车。

facts.speaker: porter
facts.text: You’ve just missed it!
facts.cn: 你们刚好错过了那班车！

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: What! It’s only eight fifteen.
facts.cn: 什么！现在才八点十五分。

facts.speaker: porter
facts.text: I’m sorry, sir. That clock’s ten minutes slow.
facts.cn: 对不起，先生。那个钟慢了十分钟。

facts.speaker: george
facts.text: When’s the next train?
facts.cn: 下一班车是什么时候？

facts.speaker: porter
facts.text: In five hours’ time!
facts.cn: 五小时以后！

entries.title: 蓝色箱子的归属
entries.story: Mr. Hall与服务员一起核对蓝色箱子把手上的标签
entries.direction: Mr. Hall and the attendant examine the label on the handle of ONE BLUE suitcase. Two adults with visible shoes. Label has no legible writing. No second identical suitcase or exchange already completed.

facts.speaker: hall
facts.text: I left a suitcase on the train to London the other day.
facts.cn: 几天前我把一只手提箱遗留在开往伦敦的火车上了。

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: Can you describe it, sir?
facts.cn: 先生，您能描述一下它吗？

facts.speaker: hall
facts.text: It’s a small blue case and it’s got a zip. There’s a label on the handle with my name and address on it.
facts.cn: 它是一只蓝色的小箱子，有拉链。把手上有个标签，写着我的姓名和地址。

facts.speaker: attendant
facts.text: Is this case yours?
facts.cn: 这只箱子是您的吗？

facts.speaker: hall
facts.text: No, that’s not mine.

facts.speaker: attendant

facts.speaker: john
facts.text: Yes, speaking.
facts.cn: 是我，请讲。

facts.speaker: turner
facts.text: Tell Mary we’ll be late for dinner this evening.
facts.cn: 请告诉Mary，今晚吃饭我们会迟到一会儿。

facts.speaker: john
facts.text: I’m afraid I don’t understand.
facts.cn: 恐怕我不明白您的意思。

facts.speaker: turner
facts.text: Hasn’t Mary told you?
facts.cn: Mary没有告诉你吗？

facts.speaker: turner
facts.text: She invited Charlotte and me to dinner this evening.
facts.cn: 她邀请了Charlotte和我今晚去吃饭。

facts.speaker: turner
facts.text: I said I would be at your house at six o’clock, but the boss wants me to do some extra work.
facts.cn: 我说过六点会到你家，但老板想让我做些额外的工作。

facts.speaker: turner
facts.text: I’ll have to stay at the office.
facts.cn: 我将不得不留在办公室。

facts.speaker: turner
facts.text: I don’t know when I’ll finish.
facts.cn: 我不知道什么时候才能做完。

facts.speaker: turner
facts.text: Oh, and by the way, my wife wants to know if Mary needs any help.
facts.cn: 哦，顺便问一下，我妻子想知道Mary是否需要帮忙。

facts.speaker: john
facts.text: I don’t know what you’re talking about.
facts.cn: 我不知道您在说什么。

facts.speaker: turner
facts.text: That is John Smith, isn’t it?
facts.cn: 你是John Smith，对吗？

facts.speaker: john
facts.text: Yes, I’m John Smith.
facts.cn: 是的，我是John Smith。

facts.speaker: turner
facts.text: You are John Smith, the engineer, aren’t you?
facts.cn: 你是工程师John Smith，对吗？

facts.speaker: john
facts.text: That’s right.
facts.cn: 是的。

facts.speaker: turner
facts.text: You work for the Overseas Engineering Company, don’t you?
facts.cn: 你在海外工程公司工作，对吗？

facts.speaker: john
facts.text: No, I don’t.
facts.cn: 不，我不在那里工作。

facts.speaker: john
facts.text: I’m John Smith the telephone engineer
facts.cn: 我是电话工程师John Smith，

facts.speaker: john
facts.text: and I’m repairing your telephone line.
facts.cn: 我正在修理您的电话线路。

entries.title: Sally的火车初体验
entries.story: Sally和妈妈坐在火车一侧，蓝外套女士在对面拿着粉盒化妆
entries.direction: Sally and her mother sit together on one compact train bench; opposite them a woman in a BLUE coat uses a powder compact. Exactly three people, Sally clearly a child. All feet visible, no smoking or extra passengers.

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: Last week, my four-year-old daughter, Sally, was invited to a children’s party.
facts.cn: 上周，我四岁的女儿Sally受邀参加一个儿童聚会。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: I decided to take her by train.
facts.cn: 我决定带她乘火车去。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: Sally was very excited
facts.cn: Sally非常兴奋，

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: because she had never travelled on a train before.
facts.cn: 因为她以前从未乘过火车。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: She sat near the window and asked questions about everything she saw.
facts.cn: 她坐在窗边，对看到的一切都问个不停。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: Suddenly, a middle-aged lady got on the train and sat opposite Sally.
facts.cn: 突然，一位中年女士上了火车，坐在Sally对面。

facts.speaker: lady
facts.text: ‘Hello, little girl,’ she said.
facts.cn: “你好，小姑娘，”她说。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: Sally did not answer, but looked at her curiously.
facts.cn: Sally没有回答，而是好奇地看着她。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: The lady was dressed in a blue coat and a large, funny hat.
facts.cn: 那位女士穿着蓝色外套，戴着一顶又大又滑稽的帽子。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: After the train had left the station, the lady opened her handbag and took out her powder compact.
facts.cn: 火车离站后，那位女士打开手提包，拿出了粉盒。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: She then began to make up her face.
facts.cn: 接着，她开始化妆。

facts.speaker: sally
facts.text: ‘Why are you doing that?’ Sally asked.
facts.cn: “你为什么这样做？”Sally问。

facts.speaker: lady
facts.text: ‘To make myself beautiful,’ the lady answered.
facts.cn: “为了把自己打扮漂亮，”女士回答。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: She put away her compact and smiled kindly.
facts.cn: 她收好粉盒，和蔼地微笑着。

facts.speaker: sally
facts.text: ‘But you are still ugly,’ Sally said.
facts.cn: “可是你仍然不好看，”Sally说。

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: Sally was amused,
facts.cn: Sally觉得很有趣，

facts.speaker: narrator
facts.text: but I was very embarrassed!
facts.cn: 而我感到非常尴尬！

entries.title: 树林里的告示牌
entries.story: 树林局部：作者、告示牌背面、空废物筐和地面杂物
entries.direction: The writer stands beside the BACK of a small wooden notice board and an EMPTY litter basket. A few paper pieces, one old tyre and a rusty tin sit near the basket, localized story excerpt only. One adult matching the card, mildly disappointed, not collecting rubbish. Do not depict all seven cars/three fridges, do not invent a successful clean-up, no readable sign text.

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods.
facts.cn: 我住在一座被美丽树林环绕的古老小镇里。

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: It is a famous beauty spot.
facts.cn: 这是一个著名的风景点。

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods.
facts.cn: 每逢星期天，数以百计的人从城里来游览我们的小镇，并在树林中散步。

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.
facts.cn: 游客们已被告知要保持树林干净整齐。

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: Litter baskets have been placed under the trees,
facts.cn: 树下已放置了废物筐，

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: but people still throw their rubbish everywhere.
facts.cn: 但人们仍然到处扔垃圾。

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods.
facts.cn: 上星期三，我到树林里散步。

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: What I saw made me very sad.
facts.cn: 我所见到的使我非常难过。

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators.
facts.cn: 我数了数，有七辆旧汽车和三台旧冰箱。

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: The litter baskets were empty
facts.cn: 废物筐是空的，

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: and the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins.
facts.cn: 地上却满是纸片、烟头、旧轮胎、空瓶子和生锈的罐头盒。

facts.speaker: writer
facts.text: Among the rubbish, I found a sign which said,
facts.cn: 在垃圾堆中，我发现一块告示牌，上面写着：

facts.speaker: notice
facts.text: ‘Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!’
facts.cn: “任何在这片树林中丢弃垃圾的人都将被依法起诉！”
